Plot a Fitted gwasAim Object

Source: R/plot.gwasAim.R
plot.gwasAim.Rd

Produces one of six diagnostic or results plots for a gwasAim object.

"manhattan" (default)

Classic Manhattan plot with alternating shaded chromosome backgrounds. Points are coloured by chromosome; significant markers are highlighted in sig.col and labelled. One facet per requested iteration.

"outlier"

Line plot of genome-wide marker outlier statistics \(\tilde{q}_i^2/\tilde{v}_i\) per iteration.

"blups"

Line plot of genome-wide scaled BLUPs \(\tilde{q}_i/\sqrt{|\tilde{v}_i|}\) per iteration.

"effects"

Lollipop plot of estimated additive effect sizes for each significant marker, with \(\pm\) 1 SE error bars and percentage of phenotypic variance annotated. Positive effect = alt allele (dosage 2) favoured; negative = ref allele (dosage 0) favoured.

"contrast"

Allele contrast plot showing total line genetic values split by 0/1/2 dosage class at each significant marker. Requires data.

"heatmap"

Genome x iteration heatmap: tile fill encodes the outlier statistic at every marker position across all forward-selection iterations. Excluded positions are shown in grey. Detected significant markers are annotated with a filled diamond. Iteration 1 is at the top.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'gwasAim'
plot(
  x,
  genObj,
  type = c("manhattan", "outlier", "blups", "effects", "contrast", "heatmap"),
  data = NULL,
  iter = NULL,
  chr = NULL,
  chr.lines = FALSE,
  sig.col = "red",
  pt.col = c("steelblue", "grey60"),
  band.col = c("grey92", "white"),
  pt.cex = 0.6,
  cap = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A gwasAim object.

genObj

The "wgPanel" object passed to gwasAim, produced by primePanel.

type

Character string: "manhattan" (default), "outlier", "blups", "effects", "contrast", or "heatmap".

data

Data frame. The phenotypic data used in the analysis. Required only when type = "contrast".

iter

Integer vector of iterations to display. Default is all stored iterations. Not used for "effects" or "contrast".

chr

Optional character vector of chromosome names to display. Not used for "effects" or "contrast".

chr.lines

Logical. Draw vertical lines at chromosome boundaries in "outlier" and "blups" types. Default FALSE.

sig.col

Colour for significant marker highlighting and labels. Default "red".

pt.col

Character vector of length 2. Alternating point/line colours for chromosomes. Default c("steelblue","grey60").

band.col

Character vector of length 2. Alternating background band colours used in the Manhattan plot. Default c("grey92","white").

pt.cex

Numeric point/line size. Default 0.6.

cap

Numeric scalar. Upper limit for the colour scale in type = "heatmap". Outlier statistics above this value are clamped to cap and rendered in the maximum colour. Default NULL (no capping; full data range used). Not used for other plot types.

...

Additional optional arguments for specific plot types.

ncol

Integer. Number of facet columns for type = "contrast". Default 1L (vertical stack).

qtl

Integer vector. Index (genome order) of QTL to show in type = "contrast". Default NULL (all QTL).

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

gwasAim, summary.gwasAim, aimTrace, linkMap.gwasAim

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot(gwas.fit, genObj = panel)
plot(gwas.fit, genObj = panel, type = "effects")
plot(gwas.fit, genObj = panel, type = "heatmap")
} # }
